notes.title: Abandoned Void v2.1.0
notes.content:
Hello players!

I would like to tell you that I have made some improvements in the game, which are:

[list]
[*] Implemented support for Spanish language.
[*] Changes in the options menu to make it more intuitive.
[*] Updated the game to Unreal Engine 5.3.
[*] Graphical and performance improvements.
[*] Changed the good ending n°6 due to inconsistencies in the previous animation.
[*] The suit "Leaf bikini" now has a slight clothing simulation.
[/list]

I know I said that the previous version would be the last one, but I had the opportunity to translate the game and I wanted to take it, but this is the last version.

Best regards,
Escovic Games

notes.title: v2.0.2
notes.content:
Hello players!

I have applied some fixes that appeared with version 2:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that showed pixelated blood puddles in some cases.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the "Babydoll" costume to glow and reflect lights.
[*] Updated lighting and shading.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to not execute any action when answering the riddle wrongly. 
[/list]

notes.title: v2.0.1 Fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented to see the good ending n° 4 (japanese swimsuit).

notes.title: V1.1 Hotfix
notes.content:

notes.title: Abandoned Void v1.1
notes.content:
Hello players!

I have reviewed your feedback and based on it I have made some improvements and fixes in Abandoned Void:

[list]
[b][*] Increased height and radius to the lantern lighting.
[*] Improvements in the camera movement to make it smoother.
[*] Performance improvements.
[*] Added indicator light to the pages to be searched to make easier its visualization.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the monster to find the player when he was solving the puzzle.[/b]
[/list]

The new version corresponds to v1.1.

Thank you all for your comments.
Sincerely.
Escovic Games
